title: flint-input-echarts
description: Flint ChartAssemblyInput — ECharts backend (all chart types).

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference URI (allows standalone .json files to declare their schema).

data.description: Data source — provide inline rows via `values`, or a local file path via `url`.

values.description: Inline data rows (array of row objects)

url.description: Local file path to JSON/CSV/TSV data

semantic_types.description: Per-column semantic type annotations (field name → semantic type string or SemanticAnnotation object).

chart_spec.description: Chart specification — describes what to draw.

encodings.description: Channel → encoding map. Valid channels depend on chartType.

canvasSize.description: Hard ceiling on rendered size in pixels (optional)

chartProperties.description: Template-specific configurable properties. Valid properties depend on chartType.

encodings.description: Valid channels for Connected Scatter Plot
Valid channels for Ranged Dot Plot
Valid channels for Grouped Bar Chart
Valid channels for Stacked Bar Chart
Valid channels for Range Area Chart

field_display_names.description: Field name → display label (used as axis titles and legend headers)

RawEncodingValue.description: A channel encoding: an object, a bare field-name string shorthand, or an array (static series).

oneOf.description: Static series array (multiple fields on the same channel)

intrinsicDomain.description: Intrinsic domain [min, max] for bounded/scaled types

SemanticTypeValue.description: A semantic type: either a string name or a SemanticAnnotation object.

AssembleOptions.description: Layout tuning parameters. All optional with sensible defaults.

elasticity.description: Power-law exponent for discrete axis stretch (default: 0.5)

minStep.description: Min px per discrete axis item (default: 6)

maxColorValues.description: Max distinct color values before truncation (default: 24)

minSubplotSize.description: Min facet subplot size in px (default: 60)

facetFixedPadding.description: Fixed overhead in px for axis labels/titles/legend

facetGap.description: Gap between facet panels in px

defaultBandSize.description: Base px per discrete category at 300px baseline (default: 20)

maxBandSize.description: Max px per discrete category (sparse expansion ceiling)

maintainContinuousAxisRatio.description: Lock continuous axes aspect ratio (default: false)

facetAspectRatioResistance.description: Resistance to AR distortion when faceting (0–1)

targetBandAR.description: Target aspect ratio for a single band (0 = no correction)
